title: A2A: handing work to another system

questions.question: What remains with the delegating system after it asks another agent to work?
options: Responsibility for peer selection and use of the result
questions.explanation: Delegation transfers a task, not accountability for the outcome.

questions.question: When might an internal function be clearer than agent-to-agent delegation?
options: When systems belong to separate organizations
When all workers share one application and tools
When the task needs an artifact
questions.explanation: A2A is valuable across genuine system boundaries. Do not add protocol machinery inside one simple application without need.
